scenes.en: Myth or fact: does it damage your eyes?
scenes.say: Wearing someone else's glasses. Will it damage your eyes? Let's check the myth and the fact.

scenes.en: Borrowed glasses permanently damage your eyes.
scenes.say: The myth: borrowed glasses will permanently damage your eyes.

scenes.en: No lasting damage, but headache, eye strain and blur.
scenes.ta: நிரந்தர பாதிப்பு இல்லை, ஆனால் தலைவலி வரலாம்
scenes.say: The fact: they don't cause lasting damage. But they can give you a headache, tired eyes, and blurred vision.

scenes.en: Each lens is made for one person's power and the gap between their pupils.
scenes.say: Why? Every lens is made for one person's power, and for the distance between their two pupils. If these are wrong, your eyes work harder to focus.

scenes.en: Many people have a different power in each eye, or cylinder power.
scenes.ta: பலருக்கு இரண்டு கண்களிலும் வேறு வேறு பவர் இருக்கும்
scenes.say: Did you know? Many people have a different power in each eye, and some have cylinder power for astigmatism. So someone else's pair rarely suits you.

scenes.en: Wear only your own glasses. Don't let kids borrow. Blurry? Recheck your power.
scenes.say: So, wear only your own glasses. Don't let children borrow an elder's pair. And if your own glasses feel blurry, get your power checked.

scenes.en: Free eye test in our store.
scenes.say: See clearly and comfortably. Get a free eye test in our store today.
